village.title: Know our village
village.subtitle: Our identity, history and culture – the foundation for our future.
village.geo: The village lies on fertile plains with farmland on three sides, a traditional pond on the west and a link road connecting it to the block headquarters.
history: The village was settled several generations ago by farming families who chose this land for its fertile soil and the natural pond.
Over time, the village grew around the pond, the old banyan tree and the temple – places that are still at the heart of community life.
The first school opened decades ago, and since then education, roads and electricity have slowly reached every home. The next step is to make this progress faster, planned and transparent.

manifesto.title: Our 5-Year Sankalp
manifesto.subtitle: For every development point, we clearly explain:
questions: What do we want to do?
How do we want to do it?
manifesto.disclaimer: This is a draft. The final manifesto will be reviewed according to applicable election rules. All commitments are subject to available resources and government approvals.

water.title: Clean drinking water
water.problem: Some lanes face irregular water supply, especially in summer.
water.vision: Regular, clean drinking water for every household.
water.approach: Map problem areas, repair pipelines and follow up with the concerned department.

drainage.title: Drainage
drainage.problem: Waterlogging in lanes during the monsoon.
drainage.vision: Covered drainage and no standing water in lanes.
drainage.approach: Drainage survey, priority list of lanes and phased construction through available schemes.

roads.title: Roads & lanes
roads.problem: Many internal lanes are kutcha or damaged.
roads.vision: Paved, safe internal roads connecting every ward.
roads.approach: Road assessment, ward-wise priority and transparent tracking of each work.

streetlights.title: Street lights
streetlights.problem: Dark lanes at night are unsafe for women and elders.
streetlights.vision: Working street lights on all main lanes.
streetlights.approach: Audit existing lights, repair faulty ones and add solar lights where needed.

school.title: Better school
school.problem: Classrooms, toilets and learning resources need improvement.
school.vision: A school where every child wants to come and learn.
school.approach: School assessment with teachers and parents, then work with the education department.

career.title: Career guidance
career.problem: Students lack information on careers beyond a few options.
career.vision: Every student knows their options after 10th and 12th.
career.approach: Regular career sessions and a village mentor network.

skills.title: Youth skills
skills.vision: Youth trained in skills that lead to income.
skills.approach: Youth skill survey and connection with government skill programs.

health.title: Health awareness
health.problem: Limited awareness and irregular health check-ups.
health.vision: Regular camps and better use of the health sub-centre.
health.approach: Coordinate health camps with the health department and ASHA workers.

seniors.title: Senior citizen help desk
seniors.problem: Elders find it hard to access pensions and schemes.
seniors.vision: Every eligible elder gets their entitlements with dignity.
seniors.approach: A monthly help desk at the Panchayat Bhawan for information and paperwork.

women.title: Women & SHGs
women.vision: Active SHGs and women-led small businesses.
women.approach: Strengthen SHGs, skill training and market linkages.

farmers.title: Farmer support
farmers.problem: Farmers lack timely information on techniques and schemes.
farmers.vision: Informed farmers with better yields and lower costs.
farmers.approach: Soil testing awareness camps, expert demonstrations and scheme help.

cleanliness.title: Clean village
cleanliness.problem: Garbage piles and no regular waste collection.
cleanliness.vision: A clean village with regular waste management.
cleanliness.approach: Cleanliness assessment, collection points and community drives.

green.title: Green village
green.problem: Falling green cover and groundwater levels.
green.vision: More trees, revived pond and water conservation.
green.approach: Plantation drives, pond revival and rainwater harvesting awareness.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.problem: People often don't know the status of village works.
transparency.vision: Every work and its progress visible to every citizen.
transparency.approach: Regular Gram Sabha updates and public display of works and progress.

digital.title: Digital village
digital.problem: Limited access to online services in the village.
digital.vision: Easy access to digital services and information.
digital.approach: Digital help points and phased smart-village initiatives.
